risk_name: budget 太多导致主线变成 curve paper
reason: 4/8/16/32/64 plus multiple policies can dominate the narrative.
mitigation: Use original100 guarded as the main E5-A curve; move fixed/source_rich variants to appendix.

risk_name: 64-shot 过强导致 few-shot claim 变弱
reason: 64-shot may look less few-shot to some readers.
mitigation: Frame 64-shot as sensitivity upper reference; main claim remains 16/32-shot.

reason: Very small support can fail or fluctuate, which may look like method weakness.
mitigation: Predefine 4-shot as lower-bound stress; interpret as boundary rather than failure of 16/32.

risk_name: contamination 设计被误读为真实 label noise
reason: Replacing positives with benign examples is a controlled stress test, not a faithful SOC labeling process.
mitigation: Use explicit wording: controllable purity stress test; avoid general real-world label-noise claims.

risk_name: source_rich 扩展导致角色混乱
reason: Adding source_rich to every E5 table can make it look like a competing main method.
mitigation: Keep source_rich optional appendix only; original100 remains E5 main control.

risk_name: fixed / guarded 口径过多导致表格爆炸
reason: Two threshold policies across many budgets and contamination rates can create unreadable tables.
mitigation: Guarded only in main text; fixed only appendix if useful.

reason: Five seeds may be challenged for sensitivity curves.
mitigation: Keep current 42-46 for consistency; add 10 seeds only if curves are unstable or reviewer pressure demands it.

reason: New budgets and contaminated supports require full row-id audit or E3-b defense weakens.
mitigation: Generate E5-specific full support and contamination provenance logs.

reason: Budget or contamination curves may be non-monotonic with small supports.
mitigation: Report mean/min/max and feasible rate; do not force monotonic claims.

reason: Contaminants sampled from final OOD eval or attack eval would invalidate threshold/eval separation.
mitigation: Use only OOD train/validation-allowed source as predeclared training contamination pool; never final eval.

reason: Boundary/mixed attack metadata exists but exact row-id construction must be audited.
mitigation: Defer lower-purity design until row mapping is proven.
